description: Confirm or decline somebody's request for a team role that needs an administrator's yes (list_team_roles shows who waits under each role). 'decision': 'approve' — they hold the role from now, at the back of its holders; 'reject' — the request goes. They are told either way, and it is written to the board's journal. The board's owner and its administrators only.

role.description: The role, by name or id.

who.description: The person: their username or e-mail, 'me', or by Telegram — 'tg:<numeric id>' or '@handle' as their account carries it from a Telegram sign-in. Somebody named by Telegram who is not on the board is not found.

name: decide_team_role_request
title: Decide team role request
